meta.title: Vaultly — Personal Finance OS
meta.description: Track spending, plan budgets, and save toward your goals in a private workspace that lives in your browser.

common.name: Name
common.deleteDescription: This item will be permanently removed from your workspace.
common.invalidAmount: Enter a valid amount with up to two decimal places.

landing.label: PERSONAL FINANCE OS
landing.subtitle: See where your money goes, give it a plan, and make room for what matters.
landing.featuresHeading: A place for every money decision.
landing.featuresDescription: From the little things you buy to the big things you’re saving for.
landing.ledgerDescription: Track income, expenses, and transfers across all your accounts.
landing.budgetDescription: Plan a monthly limit by category and see what’s left as you spend.
landing.goalsDescription: Give each goal a target and track your progress as you add to it.
landing.recurringDescription: Keep bills and subscriptions on a schedule you can check at a glance.
landing.privacyTitle: Your data stays in your browser.
landing.privacyDescription: Vaultly saves your workspace on this device. Export a JSON backup whenever you want to keep a copy or move to another browser.
landing.finalDescription: Explore a sample workspace, then start fresh when you’re ready.

overview.title: Financial overview
overview.description: Your balances, spending, and savings at a glance.
overview.noSpending: There are no expenses in this month.
overview.noRecent: Add a transaction to start tracking this month.
overview.noUpcoming: Add a recurring bill to see when it’s due.
overview.noGoals: Create a goal to start tracking your progress.
overview.demoBody: Explore with sample data or start with a clean workspace.

transactions.title: Transactions
transactions.description: Review and manage your income, expenses, and transfers.
transactions.addHelp: Record an entry in your ledger.
transactions.name: Description
transactions.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, note, or account
transactions.emptyHint: Try clearing filters or add a transaction.
transactions.noAccounts: You’ll need an account to record a transaction.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.description: Keep the balances for your bank accounts, cards, and cash in one place.
accounts.formHint: Set the starting balance before any transactions you record here.
accounts.emptyHint: Add a bank account, card, or cash wallet to get started.

budgets.title: Budgets
budgets.description: Set monthly limits and see how much you have left in each category.
budgets.emptyHint: Choose a spending category and set a monthly limit.

goals.title: Savings goals
goals.description: Give your savings a purpose and follow each goal to the finish line.
goals.formHint: Track a savings target and the money you’ve set aside for it.
goals.contributeHelp: Record how much you’ve already set aside for {name}.
goals.emptyHint: Create a goal and give it a target amount.

recurring.title: Recurring payments
recurring.description: Stay on top of bills and subscriptions and record each payment as it happens.
recurring.formHint: Choose how often it repeats and when the next payment is due.
recurring.paidDescription: Add a {amount} expense to your ledger for today and move this schedule to its next due date.
recurring.emptyHint: Add a bill or subscription to track its next due date.
recurring.noAccounts: Create an account to attach to a recurring payment.

insights.title: Insights
insights.description: Compare monthly cash flow and see which categories drive your spending.
insights.savingsHint: Net cash flow as a share of income

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Make Vaultly yours and manage the data stored in this browser.
settings.appearanceDescription: Choose a theme and interface language.
settings.currencyDescription: Changes the display currency for existing amounts. Values keep their original numbers.
settings.dataDescription: Keep a copy of your workspace or restore it on another browser.
settings.importDescription: The backup will replace the current accounts, transactions, budgets, goals, payments, and currency on this browser.
settings.resetDescription: This permanently clears the financial records in this browser. Download a backup first if you want to keep a copy.
settings.demoDescription: Sample data replaces the financial records and currency in this browser.

errors.invalid: Check the information you entered and try again.
errors.corrupt: This file is not a supported Vaultly workspace. Your current data is safe.
errors.unreadable: The saved workspace could not be read. Download a copy before resetting it.
errors.unavailable: Vaultly couldn’t access browser storage. Check your browser settings and try again.
errors.duplicateBudget: That category already has a budget for this month.
errors.accountInUse: Move or delete the transactions and recurring payments linked to this account first.
errors.stale: This record changed since you opened it. Refresh and try again.
errors.sameAccount: Choose two different accounts for a transfer.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The page you’re looking for isn’t available.
